identity_scope: Use the four complete supplied neutral singlet molecular identities and dichloromethane absorption observations. Compound2 contains four covalently attached B–O–SO2CF3 groups; it is not a bare B2N6 ion accompanied by four free triflate counterions. Any alternative model of solution composition must be explicitly justified and balanced. Restrict conclusions to molecular solution absorption. Solid-state emission, electrochemical decomposition and device performance are not required endpoints.
